name: Color Contrast Checker
summary: Check WCAG 2 contrast ratios for text and background colors — AA and AAA, normal and large text.
description: Enter foreground and background colors as hex or rgb() to see the contrast ratio and WCAG 2 AA/AAA pass/fail for normal and large text. Includes a live preview sample.

faqs.question: What counts as large text?
faqs.answer: WCAG treats 18pt+ (or 14pt+ bold) as large text, which has a lower contrast requirement (3:1 for AA).

faqs.question: Which formula is used?
faqs.answer: WCAG 2 relative luminance and contrast ratio: (L1 + 0.05) / (L2 + 0.05).

faqs.question: Is this WCAG 3 / APCA?
faqs.answer: Not yet. This tool implements the WCAG 2.x contrast algorithm used by most current audits.
